script:
Li Changqing (The Disfigured Man)
Three years ago, Wang Er was discovered having an incestuous relationship with his sister Wang Mei. Coming from a prominent family, he and his sister were expelled from the family because the family couldn't allow such a disgraceful thing to happen. Before leaving, to revenge against the family, he stole a blue diamond from within the family. Wang Er took Wang Mei and fled to a certain town, living under assumed names. Because he was being pursued by the family, Wang Er's life was very depressing. Once, while drowning his sorrows in an underground tavern, Wang Er met a prostitute and had relations with her under the influence of alcohol. After sobering up, feeling very guilty toward his sister, he didn't publicize her existence to the outside world.
Two years ago, Wang Er's whereabouts were suddenly discovered by the family. To punish them, the family set fire to their house, wanting to burn them to death. Li Changqing woke up in time and hurriedly fled outside with the diamond, but was still burned on half his face by the flames. Wang Mei was burned to death in the house. After half a year, Wang Er waited for the situation to calm down, changed his name to Li Changqing, and returned to the town. He sold the hundred-million-yuan blue diamond to the nearby pawn shop owner Yao Qianshu at the low price of 30 million, bought a villa in town, and went to buy out the prostitute Chen Hongdeng's contract. Because of his longing for his sister, and using the excuse that Chen Hongdeng's name was already known in town and wouldn't sound good if it got out, he had her change her name to Li Meimei and live with him.
Because Li Meimei lived at home and knew too many of Li Changqing's secrets, Li Changqing was afraid she might accidentally let something slip outside, so he never let Li Meimei go out during the day, using the excuse that too many people had seen her and it was better not to be discovered. Later, when Li Meimei couldn't stay put and wanted to go out, Li Changqing refused and would lock her doors and windows when he went out. Li Meimei became much more obedient after that and even became mentally unstable from being locked up for so long. Li Changqing was quite happy to have her acting crazy - no one would believe anything she said. Li Changqing had a habit of talking in his sleep and often dreamed about that fire. Afraid of exposing too much, he never slept with Li Meimei.
Li Changqing hired a nanny Jia for the house to take care of Li Meimei's daily life. Nanny Jia was the wife of Zhen Shang, the jewelry merchant in town. Nanny Jia was a gossip and immediately recognized Li Meimei's true identity. Li Changqing had to regularly give Nanny Jia hush money to keep her from publicizing Li Meimei's existence. The nanny only worked during the day.
Li Changqing felt that what happened back then was very suspicious - why could the family find this place out of such a large area? So Li Changqing secretly investigated the truth about what happened back then in town. Li Changqing's neighbor Zhang ran a gas station in town and usually had nothing to do, but Li Changqing noticed that neighbor Zhang often went out at midnight. Li Changqing became suspicious and once saw neighbor Zhang going out at night, so he followed behind. After neighbor Zhang went out at night, he would drive to the tavern on the other side of town, enter through the back door, come out sneakily after an hour or two, and Li Changqing found that he went straight home.
On August 20th, Li Changqing discovered that shortly after neighbor Zhang came out and drove away, Yao Qianshu's wife Sister Wang walked out from the front door of the tavern. Since Li Changqing hadn't found anything suspicious about neighbor Zhang, he turned to following Sister Wang. After Sister Wang returned home, Li Changqing was about to leave when he heard quarreling from inside the house. Li Changqing came to the window to eavesdrop and heard something that shocked him. Sister Wang said inside the house: "Don't take risks anymore. You colluded with those people before and caused that couple to die horribly - isn't that enough? Now you want to get yourself killed too?" Yao Qianshu responded: "I'm doing all this for you. When I sell these things, I'll take you to the big city to live well." Sister Wang: "Who knows who you're really doing it for. You'd better not let me find out about your affairs. If you get yourself killed, all your money will be mine." Hearing these things, Li Changqing finally understood. Filled with grief and anger, he prepared to plot to kill Yao Qianshu to avenge his sister.
For the next few days, Li Changqing followed Yao Qianshu around, recording his activities and looking for a chance to strike. On August 25th, Li Changqing saw Yao Qianshu talking with Zhen Shang, the town's jewelry merchant, at a coffee shop by the main road leading to the clock tower in South Town. The two seemed to be arguing intensely about something. Afterward, Yao Qianshu and Zhen Shang left together. Li Changqing followed closely behind. The two talked for a few more sentences at the door. Li Changqing vaguely heard "11 o'clock sharp." After that, Yao Qianshu and Zhen Shang parted ways. Yao Qianshu returned home and didn't come out again.
[August 30th Evening]
At 10:20 PM, Li Changqing, as usual, said he was going out for a walk to conduct his surveillance activities. He got in his car, checked the pistol he kept in the car, smoked a cigarette inside to calm his nerves, then drove off. At 10:40, it started raining heavily. He came to near Yao Qianshu's house. After a few minutes, Yao Qianshu came out and got in his car. Li Changqing followed closely behind and found that Yao Qianshu suddenly turned off his headlights, turned a corner, and disappeared. Li Changqing didn't dare follow rashly and waited by the roadside. At 11 o'clock, Li Changqing suddenly heard a gunshot. After waiting a few minutes, a car drove past him and then drove back. Li Changqing got out of his car and quietly came to the clock tower. He found a car parked beside the clock tower. Li Changqing went forward to check and found Yao Qianshu lying in the car, shot in the head - he was already dead. Li Changqing resented not being able to take revenge personally but didn't dare stay long. At 11:20, he returned home, casually parked his car on the roadside, and entered the house. He found Li Meimei washing up at home, so he went to his room to rest.
Only Clue (Not actively exposing +10 points):
Sister Wang and Yao Qianshu's argument content.
acts_goal: Don't actively expose the content of Sister Wang and Yao Qianshu's argument.
